datasetName: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) Crime in India 2022 - Bengaluru Metropolitan City Statistics
sourceOrganisation: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
geographicCoverage: Bengaluru Police Commissionerate (Metropolitan Urban Area), Karnataka, India

violentCrimes.description: Murder, attempt to commit murder, grievous hurt, kidnapping & abduction

crimesAgainstWomen.description: Assault on women with intent to outrage modesty, sexual harassment, cruelty by husband/relatives

cyberCrimes.description: Financial fraud, identity theft, cyber harassment

epistemologicalPolicy: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) crime statistics are published strictly as aggregate municipal totals and police commissionerate summaries.
Indian official government authorities do not publish open, point-level geocoded GPS coordinates of reported crimes under open data licenses.
SafePath Finder strictly prohibits disaggregating or distributing city-wide crime numbers across individual streets or synthetic pins.
Zero incident records on a route must never be interpreted or represented as proof that an area is crime-free.
Route-level crime evidence is honestly classified as UNAVAILABLE for pedestrian street segments in the pilot corridor.
